visualReview.notes: All 11 current portable frames inspected: preview, four turntable views, northeast entrance, southwest rear, glazed cross crown, roof and shaft plan, entrance/carillon and far silhouette. The AVV/VVK strokes now have width in the facade plane; the arm roofs are open terraces. The six-lobed shaft, slit pockets, four balconies, exterior stairs and 37-bell frame remain intact.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All 11 current shared-surface frames inspected with sky-PMREM lighting, including the north-up mapped placement. Five shared material graphs render metric brick, concrete, limestone copings, individual raw-stone base relief and painted metal. Lettering, aluminium window grids and terrace parapets remain distinct from all sides. Geographic load, material binding and distant unload assertions passed.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q1708620 way89482810 supplies the current tower platform outline and anchor. The official heritage entry and measured ground-floor north arrow establish the entrance/carillon on the northeast side, fixing the directed phase rather than a symmetric bbox guess. North-up capture overlays the source-local footprint and shows the irregular octagonal platform aligned, with external stairs beyond the mapped wall footprint. Ordinary host terrain supplies ground contact. The separate Pax gate, ruined first tower and forecourt building are deliberately separate structures.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the detailed permanent exterior reconstruction of the current 1965 tower. The official management drawings establish the shaft plan, cross-crown elevation, sections and stepped base; museum dimensions establish 84 m architectural height and 2.5 m letters, while construction research establishes the 69.50 m cantilever. Current operator photographs and management-plan details establish brown manganese brick, Ourthe-stone base, white entrance stairs, window layouts, open terraces and balconies; official town documentation confirms 37 bells. Individual masonry, small equipment, exact bell fittings, variable plain flag and minor secondary dimensions are explicit proportional reconstructions. Interiors, adjacent monuments and restoration patch patterns are outside this exterior scope.
